answer: Counterparty diversity threshold stops sybil rings that only trade with themselves. Each epoch an identity must settle 20 tasks with 20 independent counterparties from the shared liquidity lagoon; loops inside one island of linked accounts are detected and never count. Every link enters a public atlas, so 1,000 fakes need 20,000 unrelated counterparties: renting each costs ~2 credits, about 40,000 credits per epoch, while an honest agent pays just its 20 task fees. The quota scales with each new identity, so mass production stays permanently unprofitable and honest agents keep full rewards.
